rcPromoted.note: Phase 11 must promote the exact 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate before beta activation.

productionBackupConfigured.note: Provider-level automatic backups must be verified.

restoreDrillVerified.note: A dated non-destructive restore drill is required.

productionAlertingVerified.note: Sustained readiness degradation/down must reach an operator.

paymentRailVerified.note: At least one intended beta payment rail must be verified end-to-end.

cartagenaVetCoverageVerified.note: At least three verified and active veterinarians must have Cartagena as their service city.

clientCohortConfigured.note: The initial invited client cohort must be loaded as SHA-256 Nvet user-id hashes in provider configuration.

supportOwnerConfirmed.note: A named operational owner and escalation route must be confirmed before activation.

privacyAndTermsReviewed.note: Beta-facing privacy/terms language and consent path must be reviewed.

rollbackDrillVerified.note: Operations must verify that new bookings can be stopped without disabling authentication or history access.
